summary: Receives ST 2110 video essences through supported professional video hardware using an ST2110 Device CHOP.

key_params.name: setupmode
key_params.note: SDP parameters or NMOS setup mode.

key_params.name: setsourceipfromsdp
key_params.note: Set source IP from supported SDP data.

common_gotchas: A connected device status does not prove a valid incoming stream.
Frame repeat/drop/skip counters should be monitored during timing diagnosis.
Source-IP assignment from SDP only applies to supported devices.
The operator is Pro-only and hardware-dependent.
key_concepts: ST2110 In TOP is a Pro-only ST 2110 video input that depends on an ST2110 Device CHOP.
Setup can come from SDP parameters or NMOS stream identifiers depending on device/workflow.
Supported hardware families include Blackmagic IP, AJA IP25, and Deltacast DELTA-ip-ST2110 devices.
Input pixel format, color space, reference white, and transfer mode affect HDR/SDR interpretation and upload behavior.
